name: Sentinel
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+ You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Guardian.description: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the Disengage action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature.

Halt.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, the creature’s Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.
